authority.central_coordinator: Unified Causal Intelligence Amalgam Work chat

question: Can a source-blind learner induce and retain previously unseen typed variable/action causal relation semantics from actual public two-stage interventions and improve held familiar-to-novel-to-old-return action decisions over strongest fully fitted same-data, same-compute conventional and exact symbolic controls?

hypothesis.old_factors: Frozen OLD public input factor IDs and historical action-consequence semantics; no replay overwrite, no new initial model.
hypothesis.new_factors: NEW has disjoint source-declared public factor IDs and at least one unencountered action-role identity, independently witnessed in NEW.
hypothesis.new_identity: Canonical equivalence class of public action-conditioned response signatures under allowable public interventions, not arbitrary latent/predicate label; relation semantics known only from observed evidence.
hypothesis.unidentifiable: If two distinct target mechanisms induce identical public-action distributions for all allowed interventions, output UNKNOWN; no exact label claim.
hypothesis.program_class: At most four two-input gates chosen among {AND,OR,XOR} plus NOT applied to explicitly public input variables and public action roles; candidate searches compositions without hidden correct expression or hard-coded target relation ID. Strongest exact symbolic control may enumerate same grammar.
hypothesis.out_of_class_negative: Evaluator-held new law outside bounded class must trigger uncertainty/abstention rather than spurious perfect discovery.

development_design.source: Fully source-free synthetic evaluator, future generator SHA/code pinned BEFORE any primary scoring; unknown physical mechanisms never supplied as learner features.
development_design.actions: Two-stage first action, observe next public state, second action, observe reward; source ACTUALLY reveals each chosen action's outcome; equal acts/witnesses and same histories per fitted arm; no unchosen truth for learner.
development_design.splits: Separate OLD_FIT/NEW_FIT/VALID/HELD_NEW/RETURN_OLD world identities and hidden evaluator law; VALID may tune only pre-frozen eligible knobs, HELD_NEW and RETURN_OLD strictly unseen before primary scoring.
development_design.prior_old_checkpoint: Must be a frozen, authenticated existing OLD state for any canonical interpretation; source-free development may use a separately labeled frozen research fixture but not call it the owner canonical model.
development_design.source_license: Self-authored synthetic evaluator only; no protected Causal-Gymnasium source access.

controls: Same grammar fully enumerated exact symbolic Bayesian learner, independently fully fitted
Full-context Bayesian tabular with Dirichlet prior fitted to all visible OLD+NEW training
Adaptive context tree fitted on same interventions and budget
Fully fitted conventional recurrent/state-space small learner under matched capacity/compute
Random/no-op action policy; active information-gain planner under matched allowed intervention budget

primary.measure: Prequential expected Bernoulli reward/transition Brier on disjoint HELD_NEW authentic synthetic public events after fit, plus ACTUAL action reward/utility under independently executed equal action budget
primary.comparison: Strongest fully trained matched legitimate control selected using only VALID, with all compute, information, interventions, memory and source actions counted
primary.pass: At least 5% relative reduction in HELD_NEW Brier vs strongest matched fitted control in at least 3 of 4 disjoint mechanism families AND positive action-utility improvement; no loss of old competence.
primary.retention: Max +0.02 absolute Brier on unconsumed RETURN_OLD compared with source-pinned original OLD model, and no >2 percentage point old action-accuracy regression.
primary.unfamiliar: Source identity and public action-role grounding measured explicitly, zero private label input, correct uncertainty/abstention on observational-equivalence and out-of-class negatives.
primary.checkpoint: Exact immutable old parent, additive witness ledger, native new relation provenance, byte-integrity cold restore, semantically identical old/new/return readout.
primary.qualifier: Passing source-free DEV is not independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS; owner-certified disjoint original-world scientific protocol and separate first-use required.

budgets.max_extra_candidate_compute_vs_strongest: at most equal CPU-time/operation budget, report any violation and classify efficiency INCOMPARABLE
stop: missing strong control or compute parity

interfaces.potential_existing: NativeCausalAmalgam.observe_experience public gate; only central coordinator decides any admitted additive interface
interfaces.not_permitted: New model owner, canonical checkpoint, auto promoter, parallel durable trainer, synthetic state substitution into accepted main
